item.title: Thinking Like an Architect
item.description:
Are architects supposed to be the smartest people on the team, making all the important decisions for developers to fill in the blanks? Certainly not.

Rather, architects make everyone else smarter, for example by sharing decision models or revealing blind spots. Architects also communicate across many organizational layers by using models and metaphors. This talk reflects on two decades working as an architect, ranging from the executive penthouse to the serverless engine room.
